home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.description: Short answers for shoppers comparing grocery prices in Bangladesh.
home.faq.q1.question: What is BazarKoto?
home.faq.q1.answer: BazarKoto is an online grocery platform in Bangladesh that helps customers compare grocery prices, check bazar rates, and buy daily essentials online.
home.faq.q2.question: Can I compare grocery prices on BazarKoto?
home.faq.q2.answer: Yes. BazarKoto helps everyone compare current grocery prices across common daily items so they can make smarter buying decisions.
home.faq.q3.question: Does BazarKoto show bazar rates in Bangladesh?
home.faq.q3.answer: Yes. BazarKoto is designed to show grocery and market price information relevant to Bangladeshi shoppers.
home.faq.q4.question: What grocery items can I find on BazarKoto?
home.faq.q4.answer: You can browse daily essentials such as rice, vegetables, fish, meat, oil, spices, fruits, and other household grocery items.
home.faq.q5.question: Why should I compare grocery prices before buying?
home.faq.q5.answer: Comparing prices helps you avoid overpaying, choose better-value items, and manage your household budget more confidently.
home.faq.q6.question: Can Bangladeshi users share local market prices?
home.faq.q6.answer: Yes. Anyone can share local market data so BazarKoto can build clearer average prices for nearby customers.

markets.faq.q1.answer: You can select an exact market in Bangladesh by division, district, upazila or city corporation, area, market name, landmark, type, and operating schedule before viewing or submitting price data.
markets.faq.q2.question: Why does exact market location matter for bazar price Bangladesh data?
markets.faq.q2.answer: Exact location helps BazarKoto compare local bazar rates more reliably because grocery, vegetable, fish, meat, and daily essentials prices can vary between nearby markets.
markets.faq.q3.question: Can I add a local market on BazarKoto?

markets.faq.q4.question: Does this page support Dhaka market price and Bangladesh market list data?

prices.faq.q2.question: What information should I include when I submit a bazar price?
prices.faq.q2.answer: A reliable submission includes the market, product, unit, price per unit, quantity, date, time, seller type, price source, quality or grade, and helpful notes.

about.hero.title: Helping Bangladesh compare daily grocery prices with confidence
about.hero.description: BazarKoto is built to make everyday grocery decisions clearer, faster, and more transparent for customers across Bangladesh.
about.card.what.title: What we do
about.card.what.description: We organize market, product, and price information so customers can compare bazar rates before they buy daily essentials.
about.card.why.title: Why it matters
about.card.why.description: Grocery prices change often. Better visibility helps families plan budgets, avoid overpaying, and make smarter choices.
about.card.grow.title: How we grow
about.card.grow.description: Community contributions help improve local averages over time and make the platform more useful for every nearby customer.
about.focus.title: Clear prices. Useful context. Better decisions.
about.focus.point.tools: Simple tools for daily household decisions
about.trust.title: Local price clarity without the noise
about.trust.description: BazarKoto focuses on the details shoppers actually need: nearby market prices, useful product context, and simple ways to keep information fresh.
about.trust.local.title: Area-based prices
about.trust.local.description: Prices are organized around selected local areas and markets, so people can compare what is relevant near them.
about.trust.reliability.title: Community signals
about.trust.reliability.description: Submitted prices may change often, so reports and updates help keep the platform practical as data grows.
about.trust.privacy.title: Respectful by design
about.trust.privacy.description: People can choose their area manually, and optional location permission is only used to suggest an approximate area.
about.confidence.title: Useful information, clearly presented
about.confidence.description: BazarKoto does not ask shoppers to treat every listed price as final. We make local grocery information easier to inspect, compare, and improve together.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: BazarKoto respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information when you use our platform.
privacyPolicy.collect.title: Information We Collect
privacyPolicy.collect.description: We collect only the information needed to operate and improve BazarKoto. This may include:
privacyPolicy.collect.item1: Market and product price information submitted through the platform.
privacyPolicy.collect.item2: Selected area information such as Division, District, Upazila, and Union/Ward.
privacyPolicy.collect.item3: Basic technical information such as browser, device, operating system, and usage signals.
privacyPolicy.collect.item4: An anonymous browser identifier to help improve reliability and prevent abuse.
privacyPolicy.collect.item5: Optional location information if you choose to use the “Use my location” feature.
privacyPolicy.location.title: Location Information
privacyPolicy.location.description: You can use BazarKoto by manually selecting your area. If you click “Use my location” and allow browser permission, we may use your location to help suggest your approximate area. You can deny location permission and still use the platform manually.
privacyPolicy.use.title: How We Use Information
privacyPolicy.use.item1: Show grocery prices relevant to your selected local area.
privacyPolicy.use.item2: Improve price reliability and submission quality.
privacyPolicy.use.item4: Maintain platform security and service reliability.
privacyPolicy.use.item5: Respond to reports, feedback, and support requests.
privacyPolicy.prices.title: Submitted Price Information
privacyPolicy.prices.description1: Prices on BazarKoto are submitted by users and may change frequently. Actual prices may vary by market, seller, product quality, availability, and time. Please do not treat every listed price as a guaranteed final price.
privacyPolicy.prices.description2: Because BazarKoto may contain a large amount of market data, it may not be practical to manually verify every submitted price before it appears. If you find any incorrect or suspicious price, please report it to us. We will review and update the information when needed.
privacyPolicy.public.title: Public Information
privacyPolicy.public.description: Market, product, and price information submitted through BazarKoto may be displayed publicly as part of the service. Technical information, location permission data, and anonymous identifiers are not shown publicly.
privacyPolicy.sharing.title: Data Sharing
privacyPolicy.sharing.description: BazarKoto does not sell personal data. Information may be processed only when needed for hosting, security, service operation, legal compliance, fraud prevention, or support.
privacyPolicy.choices.title: Your Choices
privacyPolicy.choices.item3: Clear your browser storage to remove saved local preferences.
privacyPolicy.choices.item4: Contact us for privacy questions or correction requests.
privacyPolicy.updates.title: Updates to This Policy
privacyPolicy.updates.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be published on this page with a revised date.
